record: P-04 variant 1 gate (derive Realloc/Free, then genuine FString)
verdict: NOT READY FOR PREREGISTRATION - design decision required

method_1_symboled_same_version_binary.source: D:/Program Files/UE_5.4/Engine/Binaries/Win64/UnrealEditor-Core.dll (UE 5.4.4, Core built as a DLL so FMemory is CORE_API-exported with mangled names)

method_2_shipping_side_argument_shape.slot_5_Malloc: PROVEN: standalone thunk RVA 0xfab790 loads GMalloc and tail-jmps [rax+0x28] with (rdx=Count, r8d=Alignment)
method_2_shipping_side_argument_shape.slot_7_Realloc: CORROBORATED: inlined site RVA 0xfadd71 -> rcx=GMalloc, rdx=Original, r8=Count, r9d=Alignment, call [rax+0x38] -- exactly Realloc's 3-data-arg signature; second variant at 0xfae055 with the null-GMalloc init guard
method_2_shipping_side_argument_shape.slot_9_Free: CORROBORATED: many inlined sites (e.g. 0x5ced940, 0x5ced970, 0x1ddfaa5) load GMalloc and dispatch [rax+0x48] with a single data arg in rdx -- Free's 1-arg shape

slot_derivation.anchor_validating_cross_build_transfer: Malloc = slot 5 in BOTH the symboled editor build and the Shipping build, so the editor-derived slot numbering transfers.
slot_derivation.conclusion: Slots 5/7/9 = Malloc/Realloc/Free are derived with two independent lines each. NOT inferred from source declaration order alone.

blocking_finding_1.what: FMemory::Realloc and FMemory::Free have NO standalone out-of-line function in this Shipping build.
blocking_finding_1.evidence: Exhaustive scan of every .text function that loads the GMalloc global: the only small standalone thunk is FMemory::Malloc (0xfab790, slot 5). Every slot-7 and slot-9 dispatch found is an INLINED call site inside a larger unrelated function.
blocking_finding_1.consequence: There is no address to derive for Realloc/Free. They can only be reached the way the engine's own inlined code reaches them: read GMalloc, load its vtable, dispatch slot 7 / slot 9.

blocking_finding_2.what: A genuine FString cannot be constructed inside our injected DLL without several additional un-exported Shipping symbols.
evidence: FString::FString(const TCHAR*), ConstructFromPtrSize(...) and AppendChars(...) are ALL CORE_API out-of-line (UnrealString.h.inl:99-126,375-378) -- none is header-inline, so a standalone MSVC build cannot link them, and the monolithic Shipping exe exports no engine symbols.

The remaining header-inline route (FString default ctor + FORCEINLINE GetCharArray() at UnrealString.h.inl:350 + inline TArray ops) links only after supplying THREE more out-of-line CORE_API symbols, observed as unresolved externals: TSizedHeapAllocator<32,FMemory>::ForAnyElementType::ResizeAllocation, FMemory::QuantizeSize, UE::Core::Private::OnInvalidArrayNum.
blocking_finding_2.consequence: Each of those must either be derived as a Shipping address, or reimplemented by us. They are simple and well-defined (ResizeAllocation is essentially Data = FMemory::Realloc(Data, Num*Size, Align)), but reimplementing them is our code standing in for engine code, which is a design decision, not a derivation.

options_for_owner.A_vtable_dispatch_plus_minimal_reimpleme: Implement our FMemory::Realloc/Free by dispatching GMalloc vtable slots 7/9 (dual-derived above) and supply trivial local implementations of ResizeAllocation / QuantizeSize / OnInvalidArrayNum. Uses vtable slots (derived, not guessed) and 3 small reimplementations. No new address derivations needed beyond the already-derived GMalloc.
options_for_owner.B_derive_the_missing_CORE_API_symbols: Derive Shipping addresses for ResizeAllocation / QuantizeSize / OnInvalidArrayNum (and accept vtable dispatch for Realloc/Free, which have no address). More derivation work, still ends up using the vtable for Realloc/Free.
options_for_owner.C_change_the_engine_entry_point: Look for a reflected UFunction that takes the path in a form we can already build, so no FString is constructed by us at all. Not yet surveyed; would be a targeted reflection query, not a broad survey.

recommendation: Owner decision required. Option A is the smallest and uses only already-derived facts, but it does use vtable slots and three local reimplementations, both of which touch the owner's stated constraints.

evidence_class_reassessment_2026-08-28.owner_direction: Realloc/Free via GMalloc slots 7/9 are NOT to be called 'guessed slots'.
evidence_class_reassessment_2026-08-28.evidence_class: DERIVED, three converging lines: (1) same-version SYMBOLIZED UE oracle -- UnrealEditor-Core.dll's CORE_API-exported ?Realloc@FMemory@@ and ?Free@FMemory@@ dispatch [rax+0x38] and [rax+0x48]; (2) independent Shipping-side call-shape corroboration -- 0xfadd71 dispatches slot 7 with Realloc's 3-arg (Original, Count, Alignment) shape, and many sites dispatch slot 9 with Free's 1-arg shape; (3) proven slot-5 anchor -- FMemory::Malloc resolves to [rax+0x28] in BOTH builds, validating the cross-build slot numbering.
evidence_class_reassessment_2026-08-28.status: Derived and corroborated, but NOT authorized for live use. Requires an explicit owner decision before any live call.
